description.value:
Opening flesh — yours or someone else's — and working Vitae into it to prepare a Graft. Your version of "infuse."

Each day you Cut a number of Grafts from your Vitae pool. Push a Cut past your training — improvised, rushed, done on the wrong table — and you risk a Bloom.

cinderfall.incomplete: The class's entire "prepare Grafts from your Vitae pool, risk a Bloom if you overreach" mechanic is purely narrative -- no rule element models "Cut"-based crafting at all. A large fraction of this class's other cards build directly on this feat, and it has nothing real to extend.
